title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Biological Resources Institutes
title_original: 생물자원관의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Biological Resources Institutes

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Biological Resources Institutes and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Specialized Personnel and Facilities)
"Specialized personnel and facilities prescribed by Presidential Decree" in subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Biological Resources Institutes (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means the specialized personnel and facilities in the following classifications: <Amended on November 21, 2023>
1. Specialized personnel falling under any of the following items:
(a) A biological classification engineer under the National Technical Qualifications Act;
(b) A person who has worked in a field related to biological resources for at least one year after obtaining a master's or higher degree in that field;
(c) A person who has worked in a field related to biological resources for at least three years after obtaining a bachelor's or higher degree in that field;
(d) A person who has worked in a field related to biological resources for at least five years after obtaining an associate degree in that field.
2. Facilities falling under any of the following items:
(a) Laboratory facilities for discovering, collecting, conserving, and studying biological resources;
(b) Indoor or outdoor exhibition facilities for exhibiting biological resources;
(c) Collection storage facilities for collecting, conserving, and managing biological resources;
(d) Facilities necessary for conducting projects in the respective fields under Article 7 (2) of the Act.

Article 3 (Procedures for Formulating Master Plans for Biological Resources Institutes)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall formulate the master plan for biological resources institutes under Article 4 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "master plan") in consultation with the heads of relevant central administrative agencies. In such cases, the Minister shall hear the opinions of the heads of relevant local governments. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) When the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment has formulated a master plan, the Minister shall announce its contents in the Official Gazette and notify the heads of relevant central administrative agencies and local governments thereof. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 4 (Registration of Establishment)
The matters to be registered upon the establishment of a biological resources institute under Article 7 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as an "incorporated biological resources institute") shall be as follows:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Location of its principal office and affiliated institutions (limited to cases where it has affiliated institutions);
4. Names and addresses of its executive officers;
5. Method of public announcement.

Article 5 (Matters to Be Included in Articles of Incorporation)
"Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 7 (5) 13 of the Act means the following matters:
1. Matters concerning the setting of business objectives and reporting of business performance, etc.;
2. Matters concerning budget preparation and settlement of accounts.

Article 6 (Submission of Budget Requests for Contributions, etc.)
(1) An incorporated biological resources institute seeking a contribution or subsidy from the State under Article 17 of the Act shall submit an application for a contribution or subsidy (hereinafter referred to as "contributions, etc.") to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment by May 31 each year, as prescribed by the Minister, together with the following documents: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. A business plan and an execution plan for the following business year;
2. A written review opinion of the head of the National Institute of Biological Resources under Article 6 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the "President of the National Institute of Biological Resources").
(2) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment deems the details of an application for contributions, etc. under paragraph (1) appropriate, the Minister shall prepare a budget proposal reflecting those details and notify the incorporated biological resources institute when the budget for the contributions, etc. has been finalized. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 7 (Procedures for Payment of Contributions, etc.)
(1) To receive contributions, etc. under Article 6 (1), an incorporated biological resources institute shall submit an application for payment to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, as prescribed by the Minister, together with quarterly business plans and execution plans for the relevant business year. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment receives an application under paragraph (1) and deems the business plans and execution plans appropriate, the Minister shall pay contributions, etc. to the incorporated biological resources institute. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 8 (Gratuitous Use of and Profit from Public Property)
Where gratuitous use of and profit from public property is permitted pursuant to Article 17-2 of the Act, the contents, conditions, procedures, etc. thereof shall be governed by a contract between the biological resources institute using and profiting from the public property and the relevant local government.

Article 9 (Procedures for Receiving Donations)
(1) Where an incorporated biological resources institute receives voluntarily donated money or goods under Article 18 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "donations"), it shall issue a receipt to the donor: Provided, That it may refrain from issuing a receipt where the donation is anonymous or the donor cannot be identified.
(2) Where a donor designates a purpose for a donation, the incorporated biological resources institute shall use the donation only for that purpose: Provided, That where special circumstances make it difficult to use the donation for the designated purpose, it may be used for another purpose with the donor's consent.
(3) An incorporated biological resources institute shall maintain books concerning the receipt and use of donations, etc. and make them available for inspection by donors.

Article 10 (Application for Approval to Borrow Funds)
To obtain approval to borrow funds pursuant to Article 19 of the Act, an incorporated biological resources institute shall submit an application for approval containing the following matters to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, as prescribed by the Minister, together with a copy of the minutes of the meeting of its board of directors at which the borrowing was decided: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. The reason for and amount of borrowing;
2. The prospective lending institution;
3. Terms and conditions of borrowing;
4. The method and deadline for repayment of the borrowed funds;
5. Other matters necessary for borrowing and repayment of funds.

Article 11 (Types of Profit-Making Business)
The profit-making business that an incorporated biological resources institute may conduct pursuant to Article 20 (1) of the Act shall be as follows: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Admission to the incorporated biological resources institute and visits to its exhibition halls, etc.;
2. Production and distribution of souvenirs, publications, etc. related to the incorporated biological resources institute;
3. Lending and distribution of biological specimens held by the incorporated biological resources institute;
4. Distribution and use of animals, plants, microorganisms, etc. raised, cultivated, or cultured by the incorporated biological resources institute;
5. Distribution of educational programs developed by the incorporated biological resources institute;
6. Rental of the facilities of the incorporated biological resources institute;
7. Advertising using the structures and facilities of the incorporated biological resources institute;
8. Other business that the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment deems necessary for the operation of the incorporated biological resources institute.

Article 12 (Submission of Business Plans, etc.)
(1) To obtain approval of a business plan and budget pursuant to the former part of Article 22 (1) of the Act, the director of an incorporated biological resources institute (hereinafter referred to as the "director") shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment the business plan and budget for the following business year, accompanied by a written review opinion of the President of the National Institute of Biological Resources, by November 30 each year. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) To obtain approval of changes to a business plan and budget pursuant to the latter part of Article 22 (1) of the Act, the director shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment a business plan and budget reflecting the changes, accompanied by the following documents. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. A document stating the changes and the reasons therefor;
2. A written review opinion of the President of the National Institute of Biological Resources.

Article 13 (Submission of Business Performance Reports, etc.)
The director shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment a business performance report and a statement of settlement of revenues and expenditures for each fiscal year pursuant to Article 22 (2) of the Act, accompanied by the following documents. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Financial statements for the relevant fiscal year (including an audit opinion of a certified public accountant or an accounting corporation under Article 23 of the Certified Public Accountant Act) and the accompanying documents;
2. A business plan for the relevant fiscal year and a report on its implementation;
3. A copy of the minutes of the meeting of the board of directors concerning its resolution on the statement of settlement of revenues and expenditures;
4. Other documents necessary to clarify the details of the settlement of accounts.

Article 14 (Matters to Be Reported Concerning Duties)
"Matters prescribed by Presidential Decree, such as the status of performance of duties" in Article 22 (3) of the Act means the following matters:
1. The status of performance of duties under the business plan;
2. The status of management.

Article 15 (Conduct of Operational Evaluations)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall conduct an operational evaluation under Article 24 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "operational evaluation") every three years. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The detailed criteria for operational evaluations shall be as follows, according to the following categories:
1. Evaluation of the management status of an incorporated biological resources institute: The degree of responsible management and operational efficiency; the appropriateness of the management of budgets, organization, and human resources; etc.;
2. Evaluation of survey and research activities concerning biological resources: The degree of expansion of research infrastructure; the results of the operation of survey and research projects; etc.;
3. Evaluation of services to the public relating to the management of biological resources: The levels of customer satisfaction and public perception; achievements in improving services; etc.
(3) To conduct an operational evaluation, the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall prepare evaluation guidelines specifying in detail the basic approach, criteria, subjects, schedule, etc. of the operational evaluation, and notify the incorporated biological resources institute thereof no later than three months before the date on which the operational evaluation begins. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 16 (Requests for Dispatch of Public Officials, etc.)
(1) To request a State agency, local government, public institution, educational institution, or research institution to dispatch its public officials or other personnel pursuant to Article 27 (1) of the Act, the director shall submit to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment a written request for dispatch containing the following matters. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Reasons for the request for dispatch;
2. The period of dispatch;
3. The number of persons to be dispatched;
4. The fields of expertise and qualification requirements for the personnel to be dispatched.
(2) Public officials or other personnel dispatched to an incorporated biological resources institute shall comply with the service regulations, etc. prescribed by the director during the period of dispatch.
(3) An incorporated biological resources institute may pay allowances to public officials or other personnel dispatched to the incorporated biological resources institute in accordance with the standards prescribed by its articles of incorporation: Provided, That allowances paid to dispatched persons who are public officials shall not exceed the standards applicable to the following categories:
1. For State public officials: The standards prescribed by the Minister of Personnel Management pursuant to Article 41 (8) of the Decree on the Appointment of Public Officials;
2. For local public officials: The standards prescribed by the Minister of the Interior and Safety pursuant to Article 27-2 (6) of the Decree on the Appointment of Local Public Officials.

Article 17 (Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines)
The criteria for the imposition of administrative fines under Article 33 (1) of the Act shall be as set forth in the attached Table.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 30482, February 25, 2020>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on February 27, 2020.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines)
Dispositions imposing administrative fines for violations committed before this Decree enters into force shall be included when calculating the number of violations under the amended provisions of subparagraph 2 of the attached Table.

Article 3 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) The Enforcement Decree of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act is partially amended as follows:

In subparagraph 3 of Article 13-4, "under Article 39 of the Act" shall be replaced with "under subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Biological Resources Institutes".

Subparagraph 1 of Article 14 shall be amended as follows:
1. A biological resources institute under subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Biological Resources Institutes.

Article 24-2 and Articles 25 through 27 shall each be deleted.

(2) The Enforcement Decree of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act is partially amended as follows:

In subparagraph 2 of Article 55-3, "pursuant to Article 39 (1) of the Wildlife Protection and Management Act" shall be replaced with "pursuant to subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Biological Resources Institutes".

ADDENDA (Presidential Decree on Partial Amendments to 20 Statutes and Regulations to Reduce Discrimination Based on Educational Attainment in Employment, etc.) <Presidential Decree No. 33886, November 21, 2023>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 35804, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That, among the Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 6 of the Addenda, the provisions amending Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (28) Omitted.

(29) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Biological Resources Institutes is partially amended as follows:

In the former part of Article 3 (1), Article 3 (2), the portion of Article 6 (1) other than its subparagraphs, Article 6 (2), Article 7 (1) and (2), the portion of Article 10 other than its subparagraphs, subparagraph 8 of Article 11, Article 12 (1), the portion of Article 12 (2) other than its subparagraphs, the portion of Article 13 other than its subparagraphs, Article 15 (1) and (3), and the portion of Article 16 (1) other than its subparagraphs, each occurrence of "Minister of Environment" shall be replaced with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment".

(30) through (80) Omitted.
